We can use fraction models to multiply any two fractions. 

Let's figure out how to use models to compute the following product:

$$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14130839/assets/06869533fb9eae08e88187c0965c9683c3b00e8cf269b121f416ce7f473ad508.png)

Therefore,

$$
\dfrac{3}{5} \times \dfrac{2}{3} = \dfrac{6}{15}.
$$
